sqlReaderQuery.value:
SELECT
    s.name AS SchemaName,
    t.name AS TableName
FROM sys.tables AS t
INNER JOIN sys.schemas AS s
    ON t.schema_id = s.schema_id
WHERE s.name IN (
    'audit', 'customer', 'finance', 'hr', 'inventory',
    'marketing', 'metadata', 'product', 'reference', 'sales',
    'shipping', 'staging', 'support'
)
AND t.is_ms_shipped = 0
AND NOT (
    s.name = 'audit'
    AND t.name = 'ADFCopyValidationLog'
)
ORDER BY s.name, t.name;

sqlReaderQuery.value:
WITH RankedRules AS
(
    SELECT
        dqr.record_id AS RuleID,
        tc.source_schema,
        tc.source_table,
        dqr.column_name,
        dqr.rule_name,
        dqr.rule_type,
        dqr.severity,
        dqr.table_configuration_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER
        (
            PARTITION BY
                tc.source_schema,
                tc.source_table,
                dqr.column_name,
                dqr.rule_name,
                dqr.rule_type,
                dqr.rule_expression,
                dqr.severity,
                dqr.comparison_operator,
                dqr.allowed_values,
                dqr.comparison_value
            ORDER BY dqr.record_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM metadata.DataQualityRules AS dqr
    INNER JOIN metadata.TableConfigurations AS tc
        ON tc.record_id = dqr.table_configuration_id
    WHERE dqr.is_active = 1
      AND tc.is_active = 1
)
SELECT
    RuleID,
    source_schema,
    source_table,
    column_name,
    rule_name,
    rule_type,
    severity,
    table_configuration_id
FROM RankedRules
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY source_schema, source_table, RuleID;
